nigeria_market_note: Nigeria’s parallel ranges combine three independent current-day observations dated 4 Nov, updated at 09:06, 09:38 and 11:17 WAT and rechecked at 13:30 WAT. EUR displays material cross-source dispersion; the complete observed range is preserved rather than forcing a single quote. CBN benchmark rates are those of 3 Nov, the latest posted. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
